msg: Hi, The goal is to always get as many mushrooms as possible. The game always shows you one of 4 sets of Gnomes and these do not change at all. The only thing that matters is getting to the right forest that currently is giving a higher reward. I remember the gnomes that take you to the dark forest (Pink, yellow, purple,brown) so the easy thing to do is remember these 4 and press them if dark is paying out. If not then select the option that is not currently on the screen as one of those 4 will always be present. No other option like left or right position seems to matter at all. Good luck.
